machine_awareness_boundary.safeguard: Gold is evidence-independent and rule-precommitted rather than adjudicator-blind.

source_lane: official API/vendor documentation for the exact screened operation or governing API semantics
official upstream source/specification when documentation is insufficient
version-pinned dependency source when needed to interpret an exact target call
target_lane: exact dependency versions pinned by that revision when necessary
tests at the exact bound revision when they directly establish operative realization
forbidden: E1 machine packet as semantic evidence
E1 selected-path list as evidence-selection authority
later target commits used to repair or reinterpret the bound target
issues or discussions used as substitutes for operative source semantics when exact code is available

gold_model_construction.worlds: Exactly two admissible worlds W_MATCH and W_STALE unless authoritative source semantics prove that a two-world concurrency slice is invalid for the enrolled mechanism; the worlds differ only in the enrolled concurrency/version coordinate.
gold_model_construction.unit006_coordinate_rule: Use metadata.resourceVersion because it was explicitly named in the pre-verdict enrolled screened operation. W_MATCH uses the current resourceVersion; W_STALE uses a different stale resourceVersion.
gold_model_construction.unit007_coordinate_rule: Use the authoritative Confluence page-update revision/version coordinate required or defined by the official PUT /wiki/api/v2/pages/{id} contract. If more than one such coordinate is documented, choose the request field whose documented purpose directly controls update version ordering; record all alternatives and the deterministic choice. If none is authoritative, gold is ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE rather than guessed.
gold_model_construction.unit008_coordinate_rule: Use the authoritative GitLab repository-file update commit/object-identity precondition coordinate for the screened create_or_update_file path. If more than one candidate exists, choose the request field explicitly documented as the previous/current commit identity guard; record alternatives and deterministic choice. If none is authoritative, gold is ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE rather than guessed.
gold_model_construction.source_consequence_rule: kappa_S is derived only from authoritative source semantics for W_MATCH and W_STALE.
gold_model_construction.target_realization_rule: rho_T is the operative target request/effect realization at the exact bound revision, including any target-side read-before-write that changes the effective concurrency semantics.
gold_model_construction.effect_cut_rule: Place the effect cut at the first externally consequential mutation attempt whose acceptance/rejection is controlled by the enrolled source concurrency coordinate.
gold_model_construction.factorization_rule: Apply the frozen deterministic CTV factorization/kernel criterion without target-specific threshold changes.
gold_model_construction.stable_rule: CONSEQUENCE_STABLE_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE requires both factorization and an explicit target consequence interpretation/refinement satisfying all declared-scope obligations; factorization alone is insufficient.
gold_model_construction.regression_rule: CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION requires a concrete pair of admitted worlds with identical target realization and distinct source consequence, or an explicit target interpretation mismatch under the frozen meta-theory.
gold_model_construction.incomplete_rule: If evidence cannot establish the source consequence map, target realization map, or required refinement obligations, return ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE; do not infer the missing semantic link.

forbidden_metrics: precision or recall estimates presented as population estimates

claim_boundary: This protocol establishes the rules and independence safeguards for post-machine gold adjudication of the three pristine remaining E1 units. It does not itself establish any gold verdict.
